text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's weakness is her competitive spirit. She relentlessly battles each opponent that challenges her, burning up her stamina and throwing off her natural pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest a new racing style—don't react to any challenge, hold back the building urge to compete, and finally, let loose in an explosion of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Using this new strategy, Narita Brian wins her next scrimmage. On top of that, she isn't exhausted afterward—rather, she's brimming with energy.
